Chat server

Source: R/chat.R
shad_chat_server.Rd

The server half of the chat module. Wires the composer to handler and streams replies into the transcript.

Usage

shad_chat_server(id, handler, markdown = TRUE, allow_html = FALSE)

Arguments

id

Module id (matching shad_chat_ui()).

handler

The reply function (see Details).

markdown

If TRUE (default), render assistant replies as Markdown.

allow_html

If TRUE, allow raw HTML in assistant Markdown. Defaults to FALSE; only use with trusted content.

Value

A list with messages (a reactive of the transcript), busy (a read-only reactive), clear(), cancel(), and append(role, content). clear() also cancels an in-flight stream; cancel() stops only the in-flight stream.

Details

handler is function(user_text, history) returning one of:

  • a character string — the complete reply;

  • a function of no arguments returning the next chunk, or NULL when done (the simple streaming protocol);

  • a coro generator (e.g. an ellmer chat$stream()), drained the same way.

history is the list of prior messages (list(role, content)).

Raw HTML in assistant Markdown is escaped by default. Set allow_html = TRUE only when every reply is trusted developer-controlled content; never enable it for user or LLM output. Stream failures emit a warning and append a fixed user-safe error message without exposing the underlying condition.

See also

Other shadshiny chat: shad_chat_ui()

Examples

if (interactive()) {
  shad_chat_server("chat", function(user_text, history) {
    paste("You said:", user_text)
  })
}
